title: Ping body
description: Optional body of GET|POST {prober}/ping/{token}[/start|/fail]. The token in the path is the credential; the body is optional context passed through into the resulting verdict. Pings are fire-and-forget from site code with a short timeout and must never throw, so the prober answers 200 immediately after one state write. An absent or unparseable body is not an error — the ping still counts.

duration_ms.description: How long the job or deploy took, for a finish or fail ping.
